citations.title: Machine temperature alarm (synthetic plant SOP)
citations.text: A single temperature alarm that is not confirmed by a second sensor (vibration or air temperature) is verified first: a technician checks the machine before the line is stopped. A confirmed alarm stops the machine and starts SOP-LOTO-01.

citations.title: The control of hazardous energy (lockout/tagout).
citations.text: (c) General—(1) Energy control program. The employer shall establish a program consisting of energy control procedures, employee training and periodic inspections to ensure that before any employee performs any servicing or maintenance on a machine or equipment where the unexpected energizing, start up or release of stored energy could occur and cause injury, the machine or equipment shall be isolated from the energy source, and rendered inoperative.

citations.title: The control of hazardous energy (lockout/tagout).
citations.text: (4) Energy control procedure. (i) Procedures shall be developed, documented and utilized for the control of potentially hazardous energy when employees are engaged in the activities covered by this section.

agents.name: reflex
agents.role: Geofences the incident and stops or re-routes AGVs at once (rules only, under 100 ms)

agents.name: monitor
agents.role: Classifies the alarm as real or sensor noise from thresholds and Bosch vibration evidence

agents.name: candidates
agents.role: Ranks qualified workers and healthy AGVs from the Meterless World Model (one Zetaris query)

agents.name: planner
agents.role: Nemotron (deep lane) chooses among the candidates and cites the governing clauses

agents.name: critic
agents.role: Checks the plan against OSHA-based safety rules and cites the exact clause for each violation

agents.name: dryrun
agents.role: Simulates the plan for 60 s headless (A* with a reservation table) and checks collisions and ETA

agents.name: restraint
agents.role: Decides ACT, VERIFY, SAFE_HOLD, ESCALATE or DO_NOTHING from confidence and cost
